scope: Follow-up of unresolved source-audit findings in all fourteen observations

findings.resolved: Published combined loss reproduced from differences between cumulative monthly endpoints, article now explains the operation.
findings.unresolved: Greenland 2020–2023 arithmetic mean -198.00111928125 Gt/yr versus published -199 ± 29 Gt/yr.

findings.resolved: 1958–2025 statement and summary now use the directly reproducible 443.725 ZJ from the cited monthly table, rounded to 444 ZJ.
findings.unresolved: Exact origin of differences between separately published table and original figure was not established.

findings.reason: Original repository returns 503 maintenance. Legacy author hostname fails DNS. Article continues to use the available original NOAA/WDS data rather than the inaccessible paper.

findings.evidence: Official portal works and two complete original TAR archives were downloaded and read.
findings.notClaimed: All per-glacier tables and all map rasters were not downloaded.

findings.evidence: ERA5 catalogue and Download form verified in a normal browser. E-OBS DOI resolves to correct CDS product.
findings.condition: Full ERA5 request requires login and licence acceptance. No authenticated request was submitted.

findings.evidence: Full 2024 Volumes I and III verified. Public complete PDFs are linked, with the correct chapters used.
Normal browser displays correct product, Check file list, annual files 1992–2020 and the login condition. Card links to the verified English catalogue and explicitly labels the condition.
